name: Tolima
summary_text: No department-specific legal, enforcement or incident finding was located for Tolima: the country research classified it among the units whose risk sits in the national and departmental homicide counts only, without a sub-national deviation material enough to score separately (±0.02); it is therefore assessed alongside the national position. National context from the sources: the country's monitoring bodies recorded 270 LGBTIQ+ killings in 2025 (one every 32 hours, a 63% increase on 2024's 164), with violence expanding territorially into departments where the state response is weakest; no Colombian department criminalises anything about being trans, and gender-identity recognition is administered nationally. The articles cited for this unit document the national picture (the transfeminicide in Bello, Antioquia, and armed-group 'social cleansing' in Caquetá) and none reports findings specific to Tolima.

sources.title: The transphobic murder that has shocked Colombia | International | EL PAÍS English
sources.claim_summary: El País International (14 Apr 2025): on the transphobic murder of Sara Millerey (32), beaten and thrown into a ravine in Bello, Antioquia on 4 April 2025; the case intensified national alarm over transfeminicide in Colombia. The reported department is Antioquia, not this unit.

sources.title: ‘We are killed for what we are’: trans women in Colombia targeted by armed groups | Global development | The Guardian
sources.claim_summary: The Guardian (30 Jul 2024): 'We are killed for what we are' — trans women in Colombia targeted by armed groups: more than 40 transgender women killed the previous year; armed groups in Caquetá distribute 'social cleansing' flyers and give trans women a week to leave, displacing them across departments; eight trans women killed Feb-Apr 2024, 41 in 2023. The reported department is Caquetá, not this unit.
